items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I had the privilege of hearing Louis Armstrong's Hot Five there.

ctx.x: I think you mentioned, when we were talking earlier, that about that time there were only three bands in the country that had string bass...
Oh, yes. Yes, yes. Wellman Brough was with Duke. Pops Foster with Louis Armstrong and Walter Bigham Page with Count Basie.
And did all those bands come through when you were --
